drills.title: Rewriting both factors in conversion mode
hints: Anonymous example: for a b c : Nat, (0 + a) * (b * c) = a * (c * b), in tactic mode.
Enter conversion mode and move to the left-hand side.
Split the product into its two factors with congr.
As a focused bullet for the first factor, rewrite with Nat.zero_add.
As a focused bullet for the second factor, rewrite with Nat.mul_comm.

drills.title: Equal lambdas by function extensionality
hints: Anonymous example: the function sending x : Nat to 0 + x equals the function sending x to x (annotate only the first binder), in tactic mode.
On one line: apply function extensionality, naming the variable x, then rewrite with Nat.zero_add.
